metadata.name: ShadowScan real-world repository corpus
metadata.selection: Public repositories chosen by the harness author to cover agent frameworks in six languages, MCP servers and client configurations, coding-agent configuration files, skills, A2A cards, low-code exports, IaC, provider SDKs, and hard negatives whose names collide with AI products. Not a random sample. Two candidates were excluded for size (openclaw/openclaw at 52k files and the mastra monorepo at 20k files).
metadata.labeling: Author-labeled, single reviewer, not independently reviewed. Candidate evidence came from a pattern probe written separately from any scanner's signatures; every label and evidence path was then checked by reading the files. 'agent' means agent code, a configured MCP server or client, coding-agent configuration, skills, agent cards, low-code agents or flows with AI steps, or IaC provisioning agents. 'llm' means provider SDK or API use with none of those. 'none' means no AI integration; prose, lists, crawler data and classical ML count as none. Credential evidence records that a provider-key-shaped string exists (fixtures and examples included); values were never copied.
metadata.pins: Commit SHAs from git ls-remote on the pin date; fetch uses shallow clones without Git LFS objects.
